author: Kushal
problem: Read strings S and T and print Yes if T appears as a contiguous substring of S, otherwise No.
bug_description: Loops over range(n-m) instead of range(n-m+1), so T is never checked at the very end of S.

comments.accurate: Checks whether T occurs as a contiguous substring of S
comments.wrong_behavior: Checks whether T occurs in S at a start offset below len(S) - len(T)
comments.wrong_location: Window range verified; check the equal-length case compares the full strings
